description: CRM software for Google Workspace that manages contacts, sales pipelines, projects, and client relationships directly inside Gmail.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 for public apps and personal access tokens / API keys associated with an account user for integration use.
credential_notes: API access requires an active paid subscription plan (or a 14-day free trial of a paid plan), as credentials are tied to user seats.
api_notes: Provides a comprehensive REST API covering leads, people, companies, opportunities, projects, tasks, activities, custom fields, and webhooks.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Copper; only community-driven setups if any.
rationale: Copper provides a robust, fully documented public REST API, but developer access and API keys require a paid subscription or trial plan.

evidence.note: Developer portal and API documentation overview covering REST endpoints and authentication methods.
Pricing tiers and plan features showing that access requires starting a trial or purchasing a plan.
Lists extensive endpoints for leads, people, companies, opportunities, projects, tasks, custom fields, and webhooks.
